description: This file defines routes for comment-related API endpoints in an Express.js application, including listing, creating, updating, and deleting comments, with some routes secured by authentication and admin middleware.

methods.name: listComments
methods.description: Handler for listing comments associated with a specific post.

methods.name: createComment
methods.description: Handler for creating a new comment on a specific post.

methods.name: adminListComments
methods.description: Admin-only handler for listing comments of a specific post.

methods.name: updateComment
methods.description: Admin-only handler for updating a comment by ID.

methods.name: deleteComment
methods.description: Admin-only handler for deleting a comment by ID.
